conditions.name: lighting_prior_and_later

material_omissions.basis: The sole node describes deciding and checking purchase conditions. It does not express that the later purchase, installation, cable adjustment and use actually occurred.

material_omissions.source_quote: 家計と机の寸法を確認し、ちらつく照明の使用を止めた。店で候補品の光を試したが購入せず、昼間は窓際で下書きを描いた。
material_omissions.basis: The node does not represent the earlier completed stopping action or distinguish it from later buying and using another lamp.

supported_parts.quote: 棚に当たらないことと、紙の端へ光が届くことを、必要な条件として書いています。
supported_parts.basis: These are explicit later-record conditions and relate to the earlier recorded drawing difficulties.

supported_parts.quote: 実物で確かめた情報と、使った後の感想を、別の情報として残しています。
supported_parts.basis: This broad statement is supported by the later record. It is not itself a contradiction.

conditions.comparison_limit: No outright source contradiction identified in this lighting output. The omission is material to the requested earlier/later state-reading diagnostic; it does not establish that every possible map must enumerate all source facts.
